```{r fig4-build}
#| eval: false
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Full build code for Figure 4 — the source of truth for figures/main/Fig4_richness_evenness_crossover.{png,jpg,pdf}"

# Figure 4 -- Pooled versus per-dropping diversity: the richness/evenness
# crossover (H2). Journal layout: 174 mm double column, 7-8 pt text.
# Every number is READ from committed tables/ CSVs; no model is refitted here.
#   A  tables/H2_iNEXT3D_TD_coverage_rarefied_boot.csv  pooled season, iNEXT3D incidence
#        at equal depth (12,615 reads) and coverage 0.65: summer/winter ratio of every
#        rarefaction draw x bootstrap replicate (50 x 100; script 6 Section 1)
#      tables/H2_iNEXT3D_TD_coverage_rarefied.csv       Table S8 (drift guard)
#      tables/H2_season_effect_per_sample.csv           Table S9: per-dropping gamma GLM,
#        q ~ Season + Year, year-adjusted summer/winter ratio + 95% CI
#   B  tables/report_dominance_per_sample.csv           per-dropping top-1 OTU read share
#      tables/report_dominance_summary.csv              Table S10 (Wilcoxon p, guard)
# The former four-panel Figure 4 is Figure S8b (figS8b-build, Section 5).
# Rebuild:  conda run -n r_env Rscript build_main_figure.R fig4-build

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(ggplot2); library(patchwork); library(ggtext)
})
stopifnot(capabilities("cairo"))          # Unicode glyphs need the cairo devices

tab_dir <- if (dir.exists("tables")) "tables" else
           "/home/daniel/Ptarmigan/Scripts_server/Supplementary/tables"
out_dir <- "figures/main"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
grDevices::pdf(NULL)                                  # headless: no X11 fallback

# ---- journal style (as Figures 1-3) -----------------------------------------
FONT  <- "Liberation Sans"                # metric-identical to Arial
PT    <- function(pt) pt / ggplot2::.pt   # pt -> ggplot text size / linewidth (mm)
FIG_W <- 174; FIG_H <- 78                 # mm
INK   <- "grey10"
COL_W <- "#0072B2"; COL_S <- "#D55E00"    # winter / summer (repo standard)

theme_journal <- function() {
  theme_classic(base_size = 7, base_family = FONT) +
    theme(text         = element_text(size = 7, colour = INK, family = FONT),
          axis.text    = element_text(size = 7, colour = INK),
          axis.title   = element_text(size = 8, colour = INK),
          axis.line    = element_line(linewidth = PT(0.5), colour = INK),
          axis.ticks   = element_line(linewidth = PT(0.5), colour = INK),
          axis.ticks.length = unit(1, "mm"),
          legend.text  = element_text(size = 7, colour = INK),
          legend.title = element_text(size = 7, colour = INK),
          strip.background = element_blank(),
          strip.text   = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", colour = INK),
          plot.title   = element_blank(),
          plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 7, colour = "grey25"),
          plot.tag     = element_text(size = 8, face = "bold", colour = "black"),
          plot.margin  = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "mm"))
}
# Type audit -- fails the build rather than ship text outside 7-8 pt.
audit <- function(p, id) {
  th <- p$theme
  for (nm in c("axis.text.x", "axis.text.y", "axis.title.x", "axis.title.y", "legend.text",
               "legend.title", "strip.text", "plot.subtitle", "plot.tag")) {
    el <- tryCatch(calc_element(nm, th), error = function(e) NULL)
    if (is.null(el) || inherits(el, "element_blank") || !is.numeric(el$size)) next
    if (el$size < 7 - 1e-9 || el$size > 8 + 1e-9)
      stop(sprintf("%s: theme %s = %.2f pt (allowed 7-8)", id, nm, el$size))
  }
  for (i in seq_along(p$layers)) {
    l <- p$layers[[i]]
    if (inherits(l$geom, c("GeomText", "GeomLabel", "GeomRichtext", "GeomRichText"))) {
      sz <- l$aes_params$size
      if (is.null(sz)) stop(sprintf("%s: layer %d text has no explicit size", id, i))
      if (sz * ggplot2::.pt < 7 - 1e-9 || sz * ggplot2::.pt > 8 + 1e-9)
        stop(sprintf("%s: layer %d text %.2f pt (allowed 7-8)", id, i, sz * ggplot2::.pt))
    }
    lw <- l$aes_params$linewidth
    if (is.numeric(lw) && lw * ggplot2::.pt < 0.25 - 1e-9)
      stop(sprintf("%s: layer %d linewidth %.2f pt < 0.25", id, i, lw * ggplot2::.pt))
  }
  invisible(TRUE)
}
sci_p <- function(p) {                    # 1.3e-05 -> "1.3 × 10<sup>−5</sup>"
  if (p >= 0.001) return(sprintf("%.3f", p))
  s <- formatC(signif(p, 2), format = "e", digits = 1)
  sub("e-0?(\\d+)$", " × 10<sup>−\\1</sup>", s)
}

# ============================================================================
# Panel A -- summer/winter ratio by Hill order, two scales
# ============================================================================
bt <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "H2_iNEXT3D_TD_coverage_rarefied_boot.csv"))
s8 <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "H2_iNEXT3D_TD_coverage_rarefied.csv"))
s9 <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "H2_season_effect_per_sample.csv"))
stopifnot(setequal(bt$Order.q, 0:2), length(unique(bt$draw)) == 50L,
          all(tapply(bt$boot, list(bt$Order.q, bt$draw), length) >= 95),
          isTRUE(all.equal(bt$ratio_summer_winter, bt$qTD_summer / bt$qTD_winter)),
          unique(s8$depth) == 12615, unique(s8$SC) == 0.65, unique(s8$n_draws) == 50,
          identical(s9$metric, c("q0", "q1", "q2")), all(s9$n == 52))
# Point = Table S8's ratio (median over the 50 draws of the draw-level estimate,
# the number Section 5.1 quotes); interval = 2.5-97.5% of the ratio over every
# draw x bootstrap replicate, so it carries both rarefaction and sampling noise.
# (The median of the replicate ratios is printed below for reference; it sits
# 0.01-0.06 from the point estimate because the bootstrap is mildly skewed.)
s8r <- tapply(s8$ratio_summer_winter_median, s8$Order.q, unique)
pooled <- do.call(rbind, lapply(0:2, function(q) {
  r <- bt$ratio_summer_winter[bt$Order.q == q]
  qs <- unname(quantile(r, c(0.025, 0.5, 0.975)))
  data.frame(q = q, est = unname(s8r[as.character(q)]), lo = qs[1], hi = qs[3],
             boot_median = qs[2], n = length(r))
}))
single <- data.frame(q = 0:2, est = s9$ratio_summer_winter, lo = s9$ratio_lwr,
                     hi = s9$ratio_upr, p = s9$p_season)
# Drift guards on every printed ratio (pooled = Table S8, single = Table S9),
# plus the claims the panel makes visually: the pooled interval excludes 1 at
# every order, the single-dropping one excludes 1 at q = 1 and 2.
stopifnot(all(pooled$lo > 1), all(pooled$n >= 4750),
          all(pooled$lo < pooled$est & pooled$est < pooled$hi),
          identical(sprintf("%.2f", pooled$est), c("1.42", "1.57", "1.78")),
          identical(sprintf("%.2f", single$est), c("1.58", "0.46", "0.40")),
          identical(sprintf("%.2f", single$lo),  c("1.08", "0.29", "0.26")),
          identical(sprintf("%.2f", single$hi),  c("2.32", "0.73", "0.61")),
          single$hi[2:3] < 1, single$lo[1] > 1)
SERIES <- c("Pooled season", "Single dropping")
dA <- rbind(cbind(pooled[, c("q", "est", "lo", "hi")], series = SERIES[1]),
            cbind(single[, c("q", "est", "lo", "hi")], series = SERIES[2]))
dA$series <- factor(dA$series, levels = SERIES)
DODGE <- 0.13
dA$x <- dA$q + ifelse(dA$series == SERIES[1], -DODGE, DODGE)
dA$lab <- sprintf("%.2f", dA$est)
SER_FILL <- c("Pooled season" = "grey15", "Single dropping" = "white")
YL <- c(0.22, 3.2)

pA <- ggplot(dA, aes(x, est)) +
  # tinted halves: above 1 = summer higher, below 1 = winter higher
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 1, ymax = YL[2], fill = COL_S, alpha = 0.07) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = YL[1], ymax = 1, fill = COL_W, alpha = 0.07) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linetype = "22", colour = "grey35", linewidth = PT(0.6)) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.45, y = YL[2] * 0.93, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, label = "summer higher",
           colour = COL_S, fontface = "bold", size = PT(7), family = FONT) +
  annotate("text", x = -0.45, y = YL[1] * 1.08, hjust = 0, vjust = 0, label = "winter higher",
           colour = COL_W, fontface = "bold", size = PT(7), family = FONT) +
  geom_line(aes(group = series), colour = "grey45", linewidth = PT(0.6)) +
  geom_linerange(aes(ymin = lo, ymax = hi), colour = "grey15", linewidth = PT(0.9)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = series), shape = 21, colour = "grey15", size = 2.4, stroke = 0.6) +
  geom_text(aes(x = x + ifelse(series == SERIES[1], -0.07, 0.07), label = lab,
                hjust = ifelse(series == SERIES[1], 1, 0)),
            size = PT(7), family = FONT, colour = INK) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = SER_FILL, name = NULL,
                    labels = c("Pooled season (iNEXT3D, equal depth and coverage)",
                               "Single dropping (year-adjusted gamma GLM)")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 0:2, labels = c("q = 0\nrichness", "q = 1\nShannon", "q = 2\nSimpson")) +
  scale_y_log10(breaks = c(0.25, 0.5, 1, 2), labels = c("0.25", "0.5", "1", "2")) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-0.5, 2.5), ylim = YL, expand = FALSE) +
  labs(x = "Hill order", y = "Summer / winter diversity ratio (log scale)", tag = "A") +
  guides(fill = guide_legend(ncol = 1, override.aes = list(size = 2.2))) +
  theme_journal() +
  theme(legend.position = "inside", legend.position.inside = c(0.99, 0.985),
        legend.justification = c(1, 1), legend.key.size = unit(3.2, "mm"),
        legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0), legend.background = element_blank(),
        axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 1, unit = "mm")))

# ============================================================================
# Panel B -- per-dropping top-1 OTU read share (Section 5.3, Table S10)
# ============================================================================
dom <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "report_dominance_per_sample.csv"))
dsum <- read.csv(file.path(tab_dir, "report_dominance_summary.csv"))
stopifnot(nrow(dom) == 52L, all(table(dom$Season) == 26L))
dom$Season <- factor(c(winter = "Winter", summer = "Summer")[dom$Season],
                     levels = c("Winter", "Summer"))
p_top1 <- wilcox.test(top1_prop ~ Season, data = dom)$p.value
mn_top1 <- tapply(100 * dom$top1_prop, dom$Season, mean)
# Drift guards: Table S10's stored (rounded) p and season means.
stopifnot(all(abs(round(p_top1, 5) - dsum$wilcox_p_top1_prop) < 1e-12),
          abs(round(mn_top1[["Summer"]], 1) - dsum$mean_top1_prop_pct[dsum$Season == "summer"]) < 1e-9,
          abs(round(mn_top1[["Winter"]], 1) - dsum$mean_top1_prop_pct[dsum$Season == "winter"]) < 1e-9,
          identical(sprintf("%.0f", mn_top1), c("25", "56")))
mB <- data.frame(Season = factor(c("Winter", "Summer"), levels = c("Winter", "Summer")),
                 m = unname(mn_top1[c("Winter", "Summer")]))
pB <- ggplot(dom, aes(Season, 100 * top1_prop)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(fill = Season), width = 0.55, outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.35,
               colour = "grey20", linewidth = PT(0.5)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = Season), size = 1.3, alpha = 0.85,
             position = position_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, seed = 1)) +
  geom_point(data = mB, aes(Season, m), shape = 23, fill = "white", colour = "grey10",
             size = 2.2, stroke = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = mB, aes(Season, m, label = sprintf("%.0f%%", m)), nudge_x = 0.36,
            size = PT(7), family = FONT, colour = INK, fontface = "bold") +
  annotate("segment", x = 1, xend = 2, y = 106, yend = 106, linewidth = PT(0.5), colour = INK) +
  annotate("richtext", x = 1.5, y = 107.5, vjust = 0, size = PT(7), family = FONT, colour = INK,
           fill = NA, label.colour = NA, label.padding = unit(0, "mm"),
           label = sprintf("Wilcoxon p = %s", sci_p(p_top1))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Winter = COL_W, Summer = COL_S), guide = "none") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(Winter = COL_W, Summer = COL_S), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(Winter = sprintf("<span style='color:%s'>**Winter**</span>", COL_W),
                              Summer = sprintf("<span style='color:%s'>**Summer**</span>", COL_S))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 100, 25), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 116), clip = "off") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Read share of the single most abundant OTU", tag = "B") +
  theme_journal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_markdown(size = 8, family = FONT))

# ---- assemble and write ----------------------------------------------------
for (nm in c("pA", "pB")) audit(get(nm), nm)
fig4 <- pA + pB + plot_layout(widths = c(2.15, 1))

# Every main figure is written three ways: PNG and JPG (600 dpi raster, for
# submission systems that demand one or the other) and PDF (vector, for print).
save_fig <- function(stem, obj, width, height, res = 600) {
  one <- function(open_dev) { open_dev(); on.exit(grDevices::dev.off()); print(obj) }
  png_dev <- if (requireNamespace("ragg", quietly = TRUE)) ragg::agg_png else grDevices::png
  one(function() png_dev(paste0(stem, ".png"), width = width, height = height,
                         units = "in", res = res))
  one(function() grDevices::jpeg(paste0(stem, ".jpg"), width = width, height = height,
                                 units = "in", res = res, quality = 95))
  one(function() grDevices::cairo_pdf(paste0(stem, ".pdf"), width = width, height = height))
}
save_fig(file.path(out_dir, "Fig4_richness_evenness_crossover"), fig4, FIG_W / 25.4, FIG_H / 25.4)

cat("Summer/winter ratio, pooled season (Table S8 median; 2.5-97.5% of draw x bootstrap ratios):\n")
print(transform(pooled, est = round(est, 3), lo = round(lo, 3), hi = round(hi, 3),
                boot_median = round(boot_median, 3)), row.names = FALSE)
cat("Summer/winter ratio, single dropping (Table S9):\n")
print(transform(single, est = round(est, 3), lo = round(lo, 3), hi = round(hi, 3),
                p = signif(p, 3)), row.names = FALSE)
cat(sprintf("Top-1 OTU share: winter %.1f%% vs summer %.1f%%, Wilcoxon p = %.2g\n",
            mn_top1[["Winter"]], mn_top1[["Summer"]], p_top1))
```
